feedback: Justin's confession follows the strongest inference I made before voting: the supposed neutralization correction was invented, and it specifically dismantled the poison source. It does not introduce a new document, witness or mechanism. His taking poison at the preview and later dosing the glass are newly admitted actions, but those were the available inferred route rather than a new decisive clue. The final line about somebody keeping the rest of the folder is emotionally apt and preserves his attachment to real history beyond his fraud. Chip and Elle also admit their lesser lies without becoming suddenly virtuous. The ending feels earned as characterization and confirmation, although it does not retrospectively make the pre-vote physical evidence exclusive.
